about: Custom types P4 (I1): a boot-loaded cell (harness_type_gart, map all) has monster_art for newt, the type of the map mod harness_map_type (map harness_t). At boot newt does not exist: the block waits with a warning, not a mod error. After travel newt loads before the cells, and after a menu load of a harness_t save the deferred load appends newt and replays the waiting block: the cell holds its newt art both times.
